# TopologicalMetalInsulatorTransition

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A phase transition in one-dimensional systems where the topological invariant changes, driving the system between metallic and insulating states. Offers a robust mechanism for controlling information flow in topological circuits, which could underpin fault-tolerant computing architectures.
